description: This file defines a helper class 'UserRoleManagerHelper' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Authorization\Helper'. It provides utility methods to interact with the user role management system, retrieve permission data, and check employee access rights within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerHelper
classes.description: A helper class that provides methods for managing user role permissions and access checks for employees in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Private method returning the user role manager instance from the dependency container.

methods.name: getEntityIndependentDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Returns permissions for specified data groups without considering specific employee or entity context.

methods.name: geEntityIndependentDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Returns a collection of data group permissions for given data groups without entity context.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves data group permissions pertaining to a specific employee, optionally specified by employee number.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEmployee
methods.description: Returns permission collection for data groups for a specific employee, given by employee number.

methods.name: isSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks whether the given employee number matches the current logged-in user's employee number.

methods.name: isEmployeeAccessible
methods.description: Determines if an employee is accessible either through entity permission or by being the current user.
